SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CENTRAL I.B. Station
REPORT
Date February 8, 1929
Subject (in full) Arthur R. Scott.
Made by D.I. Robertson Forwarded by [签名] [签名]

Arthur R. Scott, who is a native of Sidney,
Australia, entered the service of the Public Works Department
on September 2, 1912 and his services were terminated on
November 8, 1921. Early in 1922 he returned to Sidney with
his daughter, his wife having died in Shanghai, and obtained
employment in a printing establishment. It is also reported
that while in Sidney he purchased land and married the matron
of a certain hospital. His matrimonial venture, however,
was not a success and he is reported to have lost heavily in
an action his wife brought against him. In consequence of
this he returned to Shanghai in 1923 and for a time existed
on casual employment. About February 1924 he obtained a
situation as overseer of the reinforced concrete construction
of the North China Daily News building then in the course of
construction, which he held until early in 1925. For some
time afterwards Scott was unemployed until the Autumn of the
same year when, owing to his being in financial straits he
was given the job of Assistant Manager of the Hanbury
Institute, 38 Broadway. This position he held until April
or May 1927 when he resigned to take up his present employment
as Custodian of the Asiatic Petroleum Co., Ltd building, 1
The Bund. His present salary is $200.00 per mensem and
quarters.

Scott undoubtedly entertains radical views and is
remarkably well informed of the Labour Movement in Australia,
but it is not known nor is it suspected that he is a medium
for the distribution of Communist funds in Shanghai. In this
connection it is significant that with the advent of the
Nationalist Military forces to Shanghai in March 1927 he had

中央巡捕房
报告
日期：1929年2月8日
主题（全称）：亚瑟·R·斯科特 (Arthur R. Scott)。
制作人：督察罗伯逊 (D.I. Robertson) 转呈人：[签名] [签名]

亚瑟·R·斯科特系澳大利亚悉尼人，于1912年9月2日进入工务处任职，其职务于1921年11月8日终止。1922年初，他携女儿返回悉尼，其妻已在上海去世，他在当地一家印刷厂谋得职位。另有报告称，他在悉尼期间购买了土地，并与某家医院的护士长结婚。然而，这段婚姻并不成功，据报道，在其妻对他提起的诉讼中，他遭受了重大经济损失。因此，他于1923年回到上海，一度靠打零工维持生计。约在1924年2月，他受聘担任当时正在施工的《字林西报》大楼钢筋混凝土工程的监工，该职位他一直担任至1925年初。此后一段时间斯科特处于失业状态，直到同年秋季，由于经济拮据，他获得了百老汇路38号汉伯里研究所 (Hanbury Institute) 副经理的职位。他担任此职直至1927年4月或5月，随后辞职就任现职，即外滩1号亚细亚火油有限公司 (Asiatic Petroleum Co., Ltd.) 大楼的管理员。他目前的月薪为200美元，并提供住宿。

斯科特无疑持有激进观点，并且对澳大利亚的劳工运动了解甚详，但据查并无迹象表明，也不怀疑他是上海共产主义资金的分发渠道。在此方面，值得注意的是，随着1927年3月国民革命军进驻上海，他曾

Date ____ 9. 1. 49

February 8,    9

SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL

Dear Shelley,

With reference to your letter of February 4, 1929
re: Mr. A. R. Scott, I have to inform you that he resigned
the position of Assistant Manager of The Hanbury Institute,
38 Broadway, in April or May 1927 and since that time has
been employed as custodian of the Asiatic Petroleum Co.Ltd's
building, No.3The Bund. He is not known to be a medium
for the distribution of Communist funds nor is it known
that he is in any way connected with Soviet agents.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处转录不清〕

Capt. J. P. Shelley,
North China Command.

H Robertson
D.I.

My dear man, Shelley M.B.

With reference to your letter of February 4, 1929
re: Mr. A.A.Scott, I have to inform you that he resigned the
position of Assistant Manager of the Hanbury Institute, 38
Broadway in April or May 1927 and since that time has been
employed as custodian of the Asiatic Petroleum Co. Ltd's
building, 72 The Bund. He is not known to be a receiver
for the distribution of Communist funds nor is it known
that he is in any way connected with Soviet agents.

Yours sincerely,

Capt J. P. Shelley
Lieut. J. W. Denton
R. C. C.

SHANGHAI.

4th February, 1929.

Dear Alers,

The following information has been received
from one of our Agents:-
'Mr.A.R.Scott, Assistant Manager of The Hanbury
Institute and Sailors Home situated at 38,Broadway is a
medium for the distribution of Communist funds and
generally looks after Communist agents when first they
arrive in Shanghai.'
I shall be glad of your opinion of the above.

Yours sincerely,

A.C. (Col)
? Rey
5/2

Wm. Denton.

R.C.Alers, Esq.,
Assistant Commissioner of Police,
C.I.D., S.M.P., SHANGHAI.

Foreign Section
For inquiry and report please
JRLS 5/2/29.

我方一名线人提供了以下信息：
“百老汇路38号汉伯里研究所及海员之家副经理A.R.斯科特先生是共产主义资金的分发渠道，并通常在共产主义特工初抵上海时负责照应他们。”
